### Headline summary
- Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO amid political scrutiny while US tech stocks fell into a bear market on AI concerns. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/24/trump-reportedly-says-pardoning-jensen-huang-is-an-option-but-that-he-doesnt-think-it-will-be-necessary/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/24/yales-sonnenfeld-nvidia-is-a-detriment-to-u-s-industrial-might-not-a-champion/), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114693-tech-stock-slides-continue-despite-jensen-return-anthropic.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p24#a261125p24))
- Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, marking its return as a frontier lab with competitive coding capabilities. ([Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-gemini-4-neon-marks-gdm-s-full-return-as-a-frontier-lab/), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/googles-gemini-4-neon-is-here-can-it-beat-claude-and-gpt-at-coding-39f3186891b7?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))
- OpenAI published a preprint claiming to prove the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4, a major mathematical breakthrough. ([Two Minute Papers](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hwWlEuI359w), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p21#a261125p21))

### Jensen Huang's Return to Nvidia Amid Political and Financial Scrutiny
Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO following pressure from President Trump, sparking debates over corporate governance, state capitalism, and his personal ties to the administration, while Nvidia's stock fluctuated and faced comparisons to Enron. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/24/trump-reportedly-says-pardoning-jensen-huang-is-an-option-but-that-he-doesnt-think-it-will-be-necessary/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/24/yales-sonnenfeld-nvidia-is-a-detriment-to-u-s-industrial-might-not-a-champion/), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://theconversation.com/jensen-huangs-controversial-return-to-nvidia-poses-the-question-whats-the-point-of-a-board-297386), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/trump-says-he-considered-u-s-government-stake-in-nvidia/))

### US Tech Stocks Fall on AI Concerns
US tech stocks declined and the Nasdaq 100 entered a bear market as investors moved into Treasuries amid fears regarding the AI trade and chip stocks. ([TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114693-tech-stock-slides-continue-despite-jensen-return-anthropic.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p24#a261125p24), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-25/ai-demand-much-bigger-than-market-pricing-in-says-ives-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-25/stocks-swoon-as-ai-fears-spur-rush-to-treasuries-video))

### Google Launches Gemini 4 Neon
Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, marking its return as a frontier lab, with reports assessing its coding capabilities against competitors like Claude and GPT. ([Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-gemini-4-neon-marks-gdm-s-full-return-as-a-frontier-lab/), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/googles-gemini-4-neon-is-here-can-it-beat-claude-and-gpt-at-coding-39f3186891b7?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))

### OpenAI claims proof of matrix multiplication exponent
OpenAI published a preprint claiming to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4, a major open problem in mathematics that has occupied theoretical computer scientists since 1969. ([Two Minute Papers](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hwWlEuI359w), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p21#a261125p21), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/openai-matrix-multiplication-exponent/))

### AI's Impact on Mathematical Research
AI breakthroughs in the Riemann Hypothesis and other mathematical problems have led to a 'shock-and-awe' raid on the field, prompting Terence Tao to call for a transition to 'math 2.0'. ([Machine learning](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03835-0), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/nov/25/ai-mathematics-human-knowledge-progress-technology-industry), [Scientific American Content: Global](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/why-ais-proof-of-the-riemann-hypothesis-is-so-bittersweet/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/terence-tao-reimann-hypothesis-math-ai-solutions-advice-anthropic-openai-2026-11))

### Dell raises FY27 outlook on AI server backlog
Dell Technologies raised its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to $202 billion for the third time, citing a $132 billion backlog in AI server sales. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/dell-lifts-fy27-outlook-for-third-time-as-ai-server-backlog-hits-132-billion), [The Stack](https://www.thestack.technology/dell-our-132bn-ai-server-backlog-is-real-honest/))

### FCC authorizes SpaceX to launch space data centers
The FCC Space Bureau granted SpaceX conditional authorization to deploy up to 1 million satellites for space-based data centers. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/science/1042278/spacex-fcc-starmind-ai-space-data-centers), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/fcc-space-bureau-authorizes-spacexs-starmind-with-conditions/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-25/spacex-receives-government-approval-to-launch-space-data-centers))

### Huawei Trade Secret Trial and Alleged Spy Affair
Huawei was convicted of trade secret theft in a US trial, while US officials told Congressional staffers there is no evidence that MSS directed Alice Huang to spy on Jensen Huang, suggesting the affair may have been personal. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3uAZt6QBHs), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p25#a261125p25), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/jury-convicts-huawei-of-stealing-us-trade-secrets-evading-iran-sanctions/))
